title: El Rey vs. the Evil Dr. Maskenstein
description: El Rey fights crime, drives fast cars, and always gets the girl. This time he faces off with Dr. Maskenstein, whose legion of elite, bone-crushing Wrestle Bots is poised to take over the world.
